parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift. The two methods — CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.fetchesCachedArtworkWithoutReleaseTitle (line 593) and CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.skipsEmptyReleaseTitle (line 649) — are test cases that, despite a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, intentionally exercise distinct edge-case scenarios around release-title handling. Merging or genericising them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated failure modes. The restraint rule for test fixtures dominates any generic-function signal here.
